title: Battlepack section 30 — Technicks

container.notes: Section 30 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 file offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill; see container-battlepack). The section is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8 = 8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by entryCount packed 8-byte entries and zero padding to a multiple of 16 bytes (see container-st2e).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of rows (24 in the vanilla game, TK L825).

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 8 (0x8) for this section.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: technick
records.where: st2e entries of section 30: header.entryListOffset + i*8; row i = content id 0x4000 | i (row labels: list BpTechnickList)

fields.name: actionDescriptionLink
fields.notes: One-byte description link (Workshop: "Action Description Link"); exact target not documented.

fields.name: icon
fields.notes: Menu icon (for magicks this is what makes the icon look white/black/time/green/arcane).

fields.name: actionNameLink
fields.notes: Action (section 14 row) this entry stands for; also supplies the name.

fields.name: sort
fields.notes: Sort position in the menu list.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
gaps: What actionDescriptionLink indexes (perhaps the inventory help block 10000+).
